title: Independent static audit of original non-Root late-writer launch adapter

checks.finding: The same existing parser runs before descriptor claims; it preserves Primary runtime completeness, distinct FD numbers, optional handoff dependencies and Initial-versus-learned purpose exclusion. This adapter receives only the original THREE-right writer purpose, never falls back to the old two-right marker.

Before receipt and after assembly the process must have exact actual real/effective UID/GID equal to the nonzero declared dedicated owner. The caller's expected AgentdIdentity is only a comparison; sealed original Root data and original kernel process checks provide authority.

All five original lanes and original consumer activation complete before original writer loading. Root0600 writer metadata/inode/access checks, retained original lock and actual Fleet Starting/spawn come from unchanged AgentdConfig::from_root_writer_handoff.

Optional learning and Model handoffs use the same actual Root inputs and same loaded Config identity. The Model factory receives actual connected learning inputs. Neither JSON nor a caller receipt can construct a factory; publication offers are retained without early connection.

A single session_end is captured before bootstrap I/O; subsequent phases consume only remaining time and retain the original fixed monotonic bootstrap deadline. Final checks repeat remaining deadlines and live writer proof; no original authorization is extended.

The method owns each received descriptor/Root session and acquired Config. Refusal/cancellation drops the attempt; original AgentdRootAuthoritySession::drop fences the shared live cache. There is no cloned launch, naked writer-file constructor, retry, reinitialization or restored session from data.

The new child of production_launcher legitimately constructs its parent's private Launch/RuntimeInputs. The original UID0 startup path is unchanged. Public receive_original_late_writer is a real host API with no ordinary product caller yet; it cannot manufacture Supervisor Starting.

The two normal unit tests are negative only: incomplete/aliased arguments leave original rights unclaimed, and deliberately wrong actual credentials reject before any Root offer. Their payload/identity data is not a Root capability. No positive Root restart or adopted writer is established.

metadata.changes: Each existing boundary adds only production_launcher_late_writer.rs. All old callers, definition markers, receiver restrictions and other metadata remain unchanged. One new public entry boundary and one function-ordered protected block are added.

resolved_review_finding.finding: Original draft incorrectly described reuse in the same dedicated process after its previous runtime drained.
resolved_review_finding.fix: Final comment accurately requires an already dedicated non-Root recipient of an actual Supervisor Starting admission and states that no old peer retirement, Starting creation or transfer of old retained capabilities occurs. Code bytes otherwise unchanged.
